title: Picking Coffee with Jjajja
subtitle: Sanyu's Growing Heart
author: Anthony Mwesigwa
description: Sanyu helps Jjajja pick coffee beans and discovers the dignity of hard work.
keywords: work, diligence, grandmother, coffee, Uganda, girls, virtue, humility
dedication: For every girl learning the joy of working with willing hands.
authorBio: Anthony Mwesigwa is a passionate storyteller from Kampala, Uganda, dedicated to creating engaging books for young African readers.
backCoverText: Sanyu doesn't want to pick coffee—it's hard and hot! But Jjajja's quiet example teaches her something she never expected.
